## Scope of this source assembly

Both fixed real compact smooth control slots have zero integral in every
component. The model parameters m,v are fixed and positive; the state is the
specified free vacuum. For fixed cosine frequency and kinetic time
T=tau/lambda^2, core equations (5)--(6) give the mean, Poisson free-energy
law and Wasserstein-one convergence. The proof separately controls the
mean, so it does not infer a mean from weak convergence alone. Positive
response is an existence result for suitable controls, not every control.
The threshold, zero-frequency and degenerate cases remain in the core.

The law is for the free energy H0 of the full state or its interaction
representative; their common spectral law follows from a free rotation.
No interacting-energy PVM, finite box, massless limit, growing control
resource, fixed-coupling late-time rate or physical realization is supplied.

Core section 8 is conditional on the actual ordinary-cell map, exact real
energy-adapted embedding, unital band Fock identification and common vacuum.
The finite ordered input calibration uses fixed N and fixed resources,
including P_(2N+4,N+1) for the displayed first-energy application. Its inputs
preserve compact support; their embedded images need not do so. The work
identity requires finite first energy and bounded commutator control, not
an inferred unbounded-observable estimate from trace distance. The stated
joint condition a^(N+1)=o(lambda^2) is sufficient, not optimal or necessary.

fixed omega>2m. Limits use T=tau/lambda^2 on bounded kinetic windows.
The 301-line mean core proves only mean-energy convergence. It does not itself
prove the full law, a small operator norm of Z-I, or actual-cell transfer.

The 470-line full-law core adds the full signed-input weighted Born remainder,
the small operator norm of Z-I, and the pair-coordinate/continuous trace-log

kinetic-window norm scale. They do not inherit the two-zero correlation
core's all-time arbitrary-envelope estimate or its stronger rank scale.
The rank lower bound is necessary, nonoptimal and not a detector construction.

The causal-square gain retains matrix order and nonzero internal frequencies.

massless, varying-frequency/control, modulated-drive, optimal-rate or finite-
volume conclusion is added. A failed estimate is not a no-go theorem.

Only the full-law core's final actual-cell paragraph supplies a conditional application.
